item.title: Scammers are abusing an internal Microsoft account to send spam links
item.description:
📝 For months, scammers have been taking advantage of a loophole that allows them to send spammy emails from an internal Microsoft email address typically used for sending legitimate account alerts. These crudely made emails were sent from msonlineservicesteam@microsoftonline. Updated with a response from Microsoft.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/21/scammers-are-abusing-an-internal-microsoft-account-to-send-spam/
